principle.name: Three-Layer Pattern
principle.description: Setiap endpoint punya 3 layer: 1. app/api/.../route.js — handler HTTP minimal 2. lib/controllers/...js — wrapper dgn JSDoc + response formatting 3. lib/...js — pure logic, scraper, DB calls
principle.rationale: Separation of concerns. Docs auto-generate dari layer 2. Route handler tetap ramping dan mudah di-test.

principle.name: Response Envelope
principle.description: Setiap endpoint WAJIB return format: { success: boolean, author: 'PuruBoy', result: any }.
principle.exceptions: ping.js — return { status, message, timestamp, author } — satu-satunya pengecualian.

principle.name: JSDoc Metadata
principle.rationale: Docs auto-generate dari JSDoc via scripts/generate-docs.js. Missing tags → build gagal.

convention.rule: Controller throw Error — route handler catch → return { success: false, message } dgn status 500
ping route handler exception: return { status: 'error', message }
POST handler: wrap req.json() dlm try-catch → graceful 400 utk invalid JSON
POST: const { body, origin } = await req.json().catch(() => ({}))
Both pass mockReq = { query/body } ke controller
Export dynamic = 'force-dynamic' utk endpoint data dinamis
Gunakan cloudscraper (bukan axios) utk situs protected
Cloudscraper bisa silent 403 — selalu cek response status
Pool dari lib/db.js — env var PURUBOY_PG_URL

pitfall.description: Lupa force-dynamic export → Next.js cache response
pitfall.correct_approach: Selalu tambah export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' di route handler data dinamis

pitfall.description: Error format tidak konsisten (success:false vs status:'error')
pitfall.correct_approach: Gunakan { success: false, message } di semua endpoint kecuali ping

pitfall.description: req.json() tanpa try-catch → unhandled error di Next.js
